```444:446:e:\AI\congthuong\TrainingPlan\FramePlan\UClass1.cs
if(!bolIsOnlyClassControl) // nếu không chỉ là lớp thì cần lấy thêm môn học lớp
```

/*
	NGUYỄN VĂN VIỆT		05/12/2010
	Search cho kế hoạch chi tiết về cả thêm tuần bắt đầu, tuần kết thúc

	-- 2025.09.22: Dùng fnClassOfClass để lấy danh sách lớp (gốc + ghép + tách)
	-- Truyền 1 ClassID + YearID -> tự động mở rộng đúng như fnClassOfClass
	-- V3: Merge SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V2 + fnClassOfClass
*/
Alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3]
(
	@ScienceID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@CourseID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingLevelID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingType nvarchar(500) = null,
	@BranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@ClassID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@YearID int = null,
	@Semester TINYINT = null,

	@TeacherID nvarchar(50) = null
)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 1: Mở rộng danh sách lớp (gốc + ghép + tách)
	-- Gọi trực tiếp fnClassOfClass để đồng bộ logic với TKB / sổ lên lớp
	-- ============================================================
	Declare @TblClassExpanded table (
		ClassID nvarchar(50),
		ClassType int,
		GroupSmallClass int,
		OriginClassID nvarchar(50)
	)

	Insert into @TblClassExpanded(ClassID, ClassType, GroupSmallClass, OriginClassID)
	Select
		ClassID,
		ClassType,
		GroupSmallClass,
		OriginClassID
	From dbo.fnClassOfClass(
		Case When @YearID is null Then null Else Cast(@YearID as nvarchar(50)) End,
		@ClassID,
		null,
		null
	)


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 2: Lấy thông tin lớp vào #tblClass
	-- ============================================================
	Select
		SIM_Class.ClassID,
		SIM_Class.ClassName,
		SIM_Class.ScienceID,
		SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName,
		SIM_Class.RegulationID
	Into #tblClass
	From @TblClassExpanded fn
		Inner join SIM_Class on SIM_Class.ClassID = fn.ClassID
		Inner join SIM_SpecialBranch on SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = SIM_Class.SpecialBranchID
	Where (@ClassID is not null or @ScienceID is null or SIM_Class.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @CourseID is null or SIM_Class.CourseID = @CourseID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingLevelID is null or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = @TrainingLevelID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingType is null or SIM_Class.TrainingType = @TrainingType)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @BranchID is null or SIM_SpecialBranch.BranchID = @BranchID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @SpecialBranchID is null or SIM_Class.SpecialBranchID = @SpecialBranchID)


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 3: Lấy ClassSubjectID
	-- ============================================================
	Select
		tbl.ClassSubjectID
	Into #tblCS
	From #tblClass
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject tbl on tbl.ClassID = #tblClass.ClassID
	Where (@YearID is null or tbl.YearID = @YearID)
		and (@Semester is null or tbl.Semester = @Semester)
		and (@TeacherID is null or tbl.TeachingBy = @TeacherID)


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 4: Thống kê điểm
	-- ============================================================
	Select tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		Max(case when tbl.Mark11 is not null Or tbl.Mark12 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveMark1",
		Max(case when tbl.Mark21 is not null Or tbl.Mark22 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveMark2",
		Max(case when tbl.Exam1 is not null Or tbl.Exam2 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveExam"
	Into #tblData
	From #tblCS
		Inner join SIM_SubjectMark tbl on tbl.ClassSubjectID = #tblCS.ClassSubjectID
	Group by tbl.ClassSubjectID


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 5: Select kết quả chính
	-- ============================================================
	Select
		SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID,

		SIM_Subject.SubjectID,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectName,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName as "TeacherName",
		#tblClass.*,
		SIM_Science.ScienceName,
		SIM_Regulation.RegulationName,

		CONVERT(bit,HaveMark1) as "HaveMark1",
		CONVERT(bit,HaveMark2) as "HaveMark2",
		CONVERT(bit,HaveExam) as "HaveExam",

		SIM_Class_Subject.IsLockedMark,
		SIM_Class_Subject.IsLockedExam1,
		SIM_Class_Subject.IsLocked,

		CONVERT(bit,0) as "IsEdit"

	From #tblData tbl
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject ON SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
		Inner join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID  = SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID
		Inner join SIM_Subject on SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
		Inner join SIM_Science ON SIM_Science.ScienceID = #tblClass.ScienceID
		Inner join SIM_Regulation on SIM_Regulation.RegulationID = #tblClass.RegulationID
		Left join SIM_Teacher on SIM_Teacher.TeacherID = SIM_Class_Subject.TeachingBy

END

/*
	NGUYỄN VĂN VIỆT		05/12/2010
	Search cho kế hoạch chi tiết về cả thêm tuần bắt đầu, tuần kết thúc

	-- 2025.09.22: Dùng fnClassOfClass để lấy danh sách lớp (gốc + ghép + tách)
	-- V3_Optimized: fnClassOfClass + tối ưu #temp table / index
*/
Alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3]
(
	@ScienceID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@CourseID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingLevelID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingType nvarchar(500) = null,
	@BranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@ClassID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@YearID int = null,
	@Semester TINYINT = null,

	@TeacherID nvarchar(50) = null
)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 1: Mở rộng danh sách lớp qua fnClassOfClass
	-- ============================================================
	CREATE TABLE #TblClassExpanded (
		ClassID nvarchar(50),
		ClassType int,
		GroupSmallClass int,
		OriginClassID nvarchar(50)
	)

	INSERT INTO #TblClassExpanded(ClassID, ClassType, GroupSmallClass, OriginClassID)
	SELECT
		ClassID,
		ClassType,
		GroupSmallClass,
		OriginClassID
	FROM dbo.fnClassOfClass(
		CASE WHEN @YearID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(@YearID AS nvarchar(50)) END,
		@ClassID,
		NULL,
		NULL
	)

	CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Expanded ON #TblClassExpanded(ClassID)


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 2: Lấy thông tin lớp vào #tblClass
	-- ============================================================
	SELECT
		SIM_Class.ClassID,
		SIM_Class.ClassName,
		SIM_Class.ScienceID,
		SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName,
		SIM_Class.RegulationID
	INTO #tblClass
	FROM #TblClassExpanded fn
		INNER JOIN SIM_Class ON SIM_Class.ClassID = fn.ClassID
		INNER JOIN SIM_SpecialBranch ON SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = SIM_Class.SpecialBranchID
	WHERE (@ClassID IS NOT NULL OR @ScienceID IS NULL OR SIM_Class.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
		AND (@ClassID IS NOT NULL OR @CourseID IS NULL OR SIM_Class.CourseID = @CourseID)
		AND (@ClassID IS NOT NULL OR @TrainingLevelID IS NULL OR SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = @TrainingLevelID)
		AND (@ClassID IS NOT NULL OR @TrainingType IS NULL OR SIM_Class.TrainingType = @TrainingType)
		AND (@ClassID IS NOT NULL OR @BranchID IS NULL OR SIM_SpecialBranch.BranchID = @BranchID)
		AND (@ClassID IS NOT NULL OR @SpecialBranchID IS NULL OR SIM_Class.SpecialBranchID = @SpecialBranchID)

	CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_tblClass ON #tblClass(ClassID)

	DROP TABLE #TblClassExpanded


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 3+4: ClassSubject + thống kê điểm
	-- ============================================================
	SELECT
		tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		MAX(CASE WHEN sm.Mark11 IS NOT NULL OR sm.Mark12 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HaveMark1,
		MAX(CASE WHEN sm.Mark21 IS NOT NULL OR sm.Mark22 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HaveMark2,
		MAX(CASE WHEN sm.Exam1  IS NOT NULL OR sm.Exam2  IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HaveExam
	INTO #tblData
	FROM #tblClass c
		INNER JOIN SIM_Class_Subject tbl ON tbl.ClassID = c.ClassID
		INNER JOIN SIM_SubjectMark   sm  ON sm.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
	WHERE (@YearID IS NULL OR tbl.YearID = @YearID)
		AND (@Semester IS NULL OR tbl.Semester = @Semester)
		AND (@TeacherID IS NULL OR tbl.TeachingBy = @TeacherID)
	GROUP BY tbl.ClassSubjectID

	CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_tblData ON #tblData(ClassSubjectID)


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 5: Select kết quả chính
	-- ============================================================
	SELECT
		cs.ClassSubjectID,

		su.SubjectID,
		su.SubjectName,
		tc.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + tc.TeacherLastName AS TeacherName,

		c.*,

		sc.ScienceName,
		r.RegulationName,

		CONVERT(bit, d.HaveMark1) AS HaveMark1,
		CONVERT(bit, d.HaveMark2) AS HaveMark2,
		CONVERT(bit, d.HaveExam)  AS HaveExam,

		cs.IsLockedMark,
		cs.IsLockedExam1,
		cs.IsLocked,

		CONVERT(bit, 0) AS IsEdit

	FROM #tblData d
		INNER JOIN SIM_Class_Subject cs ON cs.ClassSubjectID = d.ClassSubjectID
		INNER JOIN #tblClass        c  ON c.ClassID         = cs.ClassID
		INNER JOIN SIM_Subject      su ON su.SubjectID       = cs.SubjectID
		INNER JOIN SIM_Science      sc ON sc.ScienceID       = c.ScienceID
		INNER JOIN SIM_Regulation   r  ON r.RegulationID     = c.RegulationID
		LEFT  JOIN SIM_Teacher      tc ON tc.TeacherID       = cs.TeachingBy

END

## Nguyên nhân V3 sai

V3 cũ **tự viết lại** logic `fnClassOfClass` thay vì gọi function, nên khi truyền `@ClassID` + `@YearID` bị lệch:

| Phần | `fnClassOfClass` (đúng) | V3 cũ (sai) |
|------|-------------------------|-------------|
| Lớp ghép | Lọc `YearID = @YearID` **hoặc** có trong TKB năm | Không lọc theo `@YearID` |
| Lớp tách | Lọc `b.YearID = @YearID` **hoặc** có trong TKB | Không lọc theo `@YearID` |
| Lớp thường + `@ClassID` | Chạy tiếp block chung (gốc + ghép + tách) | Tách nhánh riêng, logic khác fn |

Ví dụ khi chọn lớp `DH21A` năm 2024:
- **fn**: trả lớp gốc + lớp ghép/tách **đúng năm**
- **V3 cũ**: lấy ghép/tách **mọi năm** hoặc thiếu lớp do join/filter sai

## Đã sửa

**Bước 1 của V3** giờ gọi trực tiếp function:

```sql

Select ClassID, ClassType, GroupSmallClass, OriginClassID
From dbo.fnClassOfClass(
    Case When @YearID is null Then null Else Cast(@YearID as nvarchar(50)) End,
    @ClassID,
    null,
    null
)
```

Các bước 2–5 giữ nguyên logic V2 (lọc khoa/khóa, môn học lớp, thống kê điểm).

**Form** `frmClassSubjectReport.cs` đã đổi store sang `SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3`.

Chạy trên SQL Server (chọn 1 trong 2 file, cùng tên proc):

1. `SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3.sql` — bản chuẩn

Đảm bảo `fnClassOfClass` đã được deploy (`fnClassOfClass.sql`).

```sql
    @Semester = 1
```

	NGUYỄN VĂN VIỆT		05/12/2010
	Search cho kế hoạch chi tiết về cả thêm tuần bắt đầu, tuần kết thúc

	-- 2025.09.22: Dùng fnClassOfClass để lấy danh sách lớp (gốc + ghép + tách)
	-- Truyền 1 ClassID + YearID -> tự động mở rộng đúng như fnClassOfClass
	-- V3: Merge SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V2 + fnClassOfClass
	--      Lớp ghép (ClassType=1): môn học lưu ClassID = BigClassID, có thể không có dòng SIM_Class
*/
Alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3]
(
	@ScienceID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@CourseID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingLevelID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingType nvarchar(500) = null,
	@BranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@ClassID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@YearID int = null,
	@Semester TINYINT = null,

	@TeacherID nvarchar(50) = null
)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 1: Mở rộng danh sách lớp (gốc + ghép + tách)
	-- ============================================================
	Declare @TblClassExpanded table (
		ClassID nvarchar(50),
		ClassType int,
		GroupSmallClass int,
		OriginClassID nvarchar(50)
	)

	Insert into @TblClassExpanded(ClassID, ClassType, GroupSmallClass, OriginClassID)
	Select
		ClassID,
		ClassType,
		GroupSmallClass,
		OriginClassID
	From dbo.fnClassOfClass(
		Case When @YearID is null Then null Else Cast(@YearID as nvarchar(50)) End,
		@ClassID,
		null,
		null
	)


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 2: Thông tin lớp (#tblClass)
	-- Lớp ghép: LEFT JOIN SIM_Class, fallback thông tin từ lớp gốc (OriginClassID)
	-- ============================================================
	Select
		fn.ClassID,
		IsNull(c.ClassName, fn.ClassID) as ClassName,
		IsNull(c.ScienceID, oc.ScienceID) as ScienceID,
		IsNull(sb.SpecialBranchName, osb.SpecialBranchName) as SpecialBranchName,
		IsNull(c.RegulationID, oc.RegulationID) as RegulationID
	Into #tblClass
	From @TblClassExpanded fn
		Left join SIM_Class c on c.ClassID = fn.ClassID
		Left join SIM_SpecialBranch sb on sb.SpecialBranchID = c.SpecialBranchID
		Left join SIM_Class oc on oc.ClassID = fn.OriginClassID
		Left join SIM_SpecialBranch osb on osb.SpecialBranchID = oc.SpecialBranchID
	Where (@ClassID is not null or @ScienceID is null or IsNull(c.ScienceID, oc.ScienceID) = @ScienceID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @CourseID is null or IsNull(c.CourseID, oc.CourseID) = @CourseID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingLevelID is null or IsNull(c.TrainingLevelID, oc.TrainingLevelID) = @TrainingLevelID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingType is null or IsNull(c.TrainingType, oc.TrainingType) = @TrainingType)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @BranchID is null or IsNull(sb.BranchID, osb.BranchID) = @BranchID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @SpecialBranchID is null or IsNull(c.SpecialBranchID, oc.SpecialBranchID) = @SpecialBranchID)


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 3: Lấy ClassSubjectID theo từng ClassID mở rộng
	-- Lớp thường / lớp tách / lớp ghép: SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID = fn.ClassID
	-- (môn OfBigClass của lớp ghép có ClassID = BigClassID)
	-- ============================================================
	Select
		tbl.ClassSubjectID
	Into #tblCS
	From @TblClassExpanded fn
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject tbl on tbl.ClassID = fn.ClassID
	Where (@YearID is null or tbl.YearID = @YearID)
		and (@Semester is null or tbl.Semester = @Semester)
		and (@TeacherID is null or tbl.TeachingBy = @TeacherID)


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 4: Thống kê điểm
	-- ============================================================
	Select tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		Max(case when tbl.Mark11 is not null Or tbl.Mark12 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveMark1",
		Max(case when tbl.Mark21 is not null Or tbl.Mark22 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveMark2",
		Max(case when tbl.Exam1 is not null Or tbl.Exam2 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveExam"
	Into #tblData
	From #tblCS
		Inner join SIM_SubjectMark tbl on tbl.ClassSubjectID = #tblCS.ClassSubjectID
	Group by tbl.ClassSubjectID


	-- ============================================================
	-- BƯỚC 5: Select kết quả chính
	-- ============================================================
	Select
		SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID,

		SIM_Subject.SubjectID,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectName,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName as "TeacherName",
		#tblClass.*,
		SIM_Science.ScienceName,
		SIM_Regulation.RegulationName,

		CONVERT(bit,HaveMark1) as "HaveMark1",
		CONVERT(bit,HaveMark2) as "HaveMark2",
		CONVERT(bit,HaveExam) as "HaveExam",

		SIM_Class_Subject.IsLockedMark,
		SIM_Class_Subject.IsLockedExam1,
		SIM_Class_Subject.IsLocked,

		CONVERT(bit,0) as "IsEdit"

	From #tblData tbl
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject ON SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
		Inner join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID = SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID
		Inner join SIM_Subject on SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
		Inner join SIM_Science ON SIM_Science.ScienceID = #tblClass.ScienceID
		Inner join SIM_Regulation on SIM_Regulation.RegulationID = #tblClass.RegulationID
		Left join SIM_Teacher on SIM_Teacher.TeacherID = SIM_Class_Subject.TeachingBy

END

/*
	NGUYỄN VĂN VIỆT		05/12/2010
	Search cho kế hoạch chi tiết về cả thêm tuần bắt đầu, tuần kết thúc

	-- V3: fnClassOfClass -> ClassID -> SIM_Class_Subject -> ClassSubjectID
	--
	-- Luu y mo hinh du lieu lop ghep:
	--   ClassType = 0 (lop goc)     : cs.ClassID = lop goc, BigClassID rong
	--   ClassType = 1 (lop ghep)    : cs.ClassID = BigClassID (OfBigClass)
	--                                 HOAC cs.ClassID = lop goc AND cs.BigClassID = BigClassID (UsedByBigClass)
	--   ClassType = 2 (lop tach)    : cs.ClassID = lop tach
*/
Alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3]
(
	@ScienceID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@CourseID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingLevelID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingType nvarchar(500) = null,
	@BranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@ClassID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@YearID int = null,
	@Semester TINYINT = null,

	@TeacherID nvarchar(50) = null
)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- BUOC 1: fnClassOfClass -> danh sach ClassID
	Select
		ClassID,
		ClassType,
		GroupSmallClass,
		OriginClassID
	Into #tblClassID
	From dbo.fnClassOfClass(
		Case When @YearID is null Then null Else Cast(@YearID as nvarchar(50)) End,
		@ClassID,
		null,
		null
	)


	-- BUOC 2: Tim ClassSubjectID theo tung ClassID tu fn
	-- DisplayClassID = ClassID hien thi tren bao cao (lop goc / ghep / tach)
	Select distinct
		cs.ClassSubjectID,
		fn.ClassID as DisplayClassID
	Into #tblCS
	From #tblClassID fn
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject cs on
			(
				fn.ClassType = 0
				and cs.ClassID = fn.ClassID
				and (cs.BigClassID is null or cs.BigClassID = '')
			)
			or
			(
				fn.ClassType = 1
				and (
					cs.ClassID = fn.ClassID
					or (cs.BigClassID = fn.ClassID and cs.ClassID = fn.OriginClassID)
				)
			)
			or
			(
				fn.ClassType = 2
				and cs.ClassID = fn.ClassID
			)
	Where (@YearID is null or cs.YearID = @YearID)
		and (@Semester is null or cs.Semester = @Semester)
		and (@TeacherID is null or cs.TeachingBy = @TeacherID)


	-- BUOC 3: Thong tin lop de hien thi
	Select
		fn.ClassID,
		IsNull(c.ClassName, fn.ClassID) as ClassName,
		IsNull(c.ScienceID, oc.ScienceID) as ScienceID,
		IsNull(sb.SpecialBranchName, osb.SpecialBranchName) as SpecialBranchName,
		IsNull(c.RegulationID, oc.RegulationID) as RegulationID
	Into #tblClass
	From #tblClassID fn
		Left join SIM_Class c on c.ClassID = fn.ClassID
		Left join SIM_SpecialBranch sb on sb.SpecialBranchID = c.SpecialBranchID
		Left join SIM_Class oc on oc.ClassID = fn.OriginClassID
		Left join SIM_SpecialBranch osb on osb.SpecialBranchID = oc.SpecialBranchID
	Where (@ClassID is not null or @ScienceID is null or IsNull(c.ScienceID, oc.ScienceID) = @ScienceID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @CourseID is null or IsNull(c.CourseID, oc.CourseID) = @CourseID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingLevelID is null or IsNull(c.TrainingLevelID, oc.TrainingLevelID) = @TrainingLevelID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingType is null or IsNull(c.TrainingType, oc.TrainingType) = @TrainingType)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @BranchID is null or IsNull(sb.BranchID, osb.BranchID) = @BranchID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @SpecialBranchID is null or IsNull(c.SpecialBranchID, oc.SpecialBranchID) = @SpecialBranchID)


	-- BUOC 4: Thong ke diem (giong V2)
	Select tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		Max(case when sm.Mark11 is not null Or sm.Mark12 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveMark1",
		Max(case when sm.Mark21 is not null Or sm.Mark22 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveMark2",
		Max(case when sm.Exam1 is not null Or sm.Exam2 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveExam"
	Into #tblData
	From #tblCS tbl
		Inner join SIM_SubjectMark sm on sm.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
	Group by tbl.ClassSubjectID


	-- BUOC 5: Ket qua - join #tblClass theo DisplayClassID (khong join theo cs.ClassID)
	Select
		cs.ClassSubjectID,

		su.SubjectID,
		su.SubjectName,
		tc.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + tc.TeacherLastName as "TeacherName",
		cls.ClassID,
		cls.ClassName,
		cls.ScienceID,
		cls.SpecialBranchName,
		cls.RegulationID,
		sc.ScienceName,
		rg.RegulationName,

		CONVERT(bit,d.HaveMark1) as "HaveMark1",
		CONVERT(bit,d.HaveMark2) as "HaveMark2",
		CONVERT(bit,d.HaveExam) as "HaveExam",

		cs.IsLockedMark,
		cs.IsLockedExam1,
		cs.IsLocked,

		CONVERT(bit,0) as "IsEdit"

	From #tblData d
		Inner join #tblCS map on map.ClassSubjectID = d.ClassSubjectID
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject cs on cs.ClassSubjectID = d.ClassSubjectID
		Inner join #tblClass cls on cls.ClassID = map.DisplayClassID
		Inner join SIM_Subject su on su.SubjectID = cs.SubjectID
		Inner join SIM_Science sc ON sc.ScienceID = cls.ScienceID
		Inner join SIM_Regulation rg on rg.RegulationID = cls.RegulationID
		Left join SIM_Teacher tc on tc.TeacherID = cs.TeachingBy

END

## Nguyên nhân thật sự

Môn **lớp ghép** trong DB **không** luôn có `SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID = 'CT2-47-N1'`.

Thường có 2 kiểu:

| Kiểu | ClassID | BigClassID | Ví dụ |
|------|---------|------------|-------|
| **UsedByBigClass** | `CD TD47A` (lớp gốc) | `CT2-47-N1` | Chính trị 2 — V2 đang lấy kiểu này |
| **OfBigClass** | `CT2-47-N1` | rỗng | Môn tạo trực tiếp trên lớp ghép |

V3 cũ chỉ join `cs.ClassID = fn.ClassID` → **bỏ qua** dòng `UsedByBigClass` (ClassID vẫn là lớp gốc).

Bước 5 còn join `#tblClass.ClassID = SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID` → môn ghép **không khớp** tên lớp ghép.

## V3 mới — logic tìm môn

```
ClassType = 0 (lớp gốc):  cs.ClassID = lớp gốc AND BigClassID rỗng
ClassType = 1 (lớp ghép): cs.ClassID = lớp ghép
                          OR (cs.BigClassID = lớp ghép AND cs.ClassID = lớp gốc)
ClassType = 2 (lớp tách): cs.ClassID = lớp tách
```

Lưu `DisplayClassID` = ClassID từ fn để hiển thị đúng tên lớp trên báo cáo.

Chạy lại `SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3.sql`, rồi:

```sql
EXEC SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3
```

	   ClassType = 2 : lop tach
	2. Voi tung ClassID tu fn -> tim trong SIM_Class_Subject (cs.ClassID = fn.ClassID)
	   -> lay ClassSubjectID, IsLocked, TeachingBy, SubjectID...
	3. Thong ke diem + tra ket qua (giong V2)

Alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_Class_Subject_BaoCaoTienDoGiangDay_V3]
(
	@ScienceID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@CourseID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingLevelID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TrainingType nvarchar(500) = null,
	@BranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@ClassID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@YearID int = null,
	@Semester TINYINT = null,

	@TeacherID nvarchar(50) = null
)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	----------------------------------------------------------------
	-- BUOC 1: fnClassOfClass -> ClassID (lop goc + lop ghep + lop tach)
	----------------------------------------------------------------
	Select
		ClassID,
		ClassType,       -- 0: goc, 1: ghep, 2: tach
		GroupSmallClass,
		OriginClassID
	Into #tblClassID
	From dbo.fnClassOfClass(
		Case When @YearID is null Then null Else Cast(@YearID as nvarchar(50)) End,
		@ClassID,
		null,
		null
	)


	----------------------------------------------------------------
	-- BUOC 2: Tim ClassID (goc / ghep / tach) trong SIM_Class_Subject
	--         -> ClassSubjectID + thong tin lien quan
	----------------------------------------------------------------
	Select
		cs.ClassSubjectID,
		fn.ClassID,
		fn.ClassType,
		fn.OriginClassID,
		cs.SubjectID,
		cs.TeachingBy,
		cs.IsLockedMark,
		cs.IsLockedExam1,
		cs.IsLocked
	Into #tblCS
	From #tblClassID fn
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject cs on cs.ClassID = fn.ClassID
	Where (@YearID is null or cs.YearID = @YearID)
		and (@Semester is null or cs.Semester = @Semester)
		and (@TeacherID is null or cs.TeachingBy = @TeacherID)


	----------------------------------------------------------------
	-- BUOC 3: Thong tin lop hien thi (chi cac ClassID co mon hoc o buoc 2)
	----------------------------------------------------------------
	Select
		fn.ClassID,
		fn.ClassType,
		IsNull(c.ClassName, fn.ClassID) as ClassName,
		IsNull(c.ScienceID, oc.ScienceID) as ScienceID,
		IsNull(sb.SpecialBranchName, osb.SpecialBranchName) as SpecialBranchName,
		IsNull(c.RegulationID, oc.RegulationID) as RegulationID
	Into #tblClass
	From (
		Select distinct ClassID, ClassType, OriginClassID
		From #tblCS
	) fn
		Inner join #tblClassID src on src.ClassID = fn.ClassID and src.ClassType = fn.ClassType
		Left join SIM_Class c on c.ClassID = fn.ClassID
		Left join SIM_SpecialBranch sb on sb.SpecialBranchID = c.SpecialBranchID
		Left join SIM_Class oc on oc.ClassID = fn.OriginClassID
		Left join SIM_SpecialBranch osb on osb.SpecialBranchID = oc.SpecialBranchID
	Where (@ClassID is not null or @ScienceID is null or IsNull(c.ScienceID, oc.ScienceID) = @ScienceID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @CourseID is null or IsNull(c.CourseID, oc.CourseID) = @CourseID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingLevelID is null or IsNull(c.TrainingLevelID, oc.TrainingLevelID) = @TrainingLevelID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingType is null or IsNull(c.TrainingType, oc.TrainingType) = @TrainingType)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @BranchID is null or IsNull(sb.BranchID, osb.BranchID) = @BranchID)
		and (@ClassID is not null or @SpecialBranchID is null or IsNull(c.SpecialBranchID, oc.SpecialBranchID) = @SpecialBranchID)


	----------------------------------------------------------------
	-- BUOC 4: Thong ke diem theo ClassSubjectID (giong V2)
	----------------------------------------------------------------
	Select
		cs.ClassSubjectID,
		Max(case when sm.Mark11 is not null Or sm.Mark12 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveMark1",
		Max(case when sm.Mark21 is not null Or sm.Mark22 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveMark2",
		Max(case when sm.Exam1 is not null Or sm.Exam2 is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "HaveExam"
	Into #tblData
	From #tblCS cs
		Inner join SIM_SubjectMark sm on sm.ClassSubjectID = cs.ClassSubjectID
	Group by cs.ClassSubjectID


	----------------------------------------------------------------
	-- BUOC 5: Tra ket qua
	----------------------------------------------------------------
	Select
		cs.ClassSubjectID,

		su.SubjectID,
		su.SubjectName,
		tc.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + tc.TeacherLastName as "TeacherName",

		cls.ClassID,
		cls.ClassName,
		cls.ScienceID,
		cls.SpecialBranchName,
		cls.RegulationID,
		sc.ScienceName,
		rg.RegulationName,

		CONVERT(bit,d.HaveMark1) as "HaveMark1",
		CONVERT(bit,d.HaveMark2) as "HaveMark2",
		CONVERT(bit,d.HaveExam) as "HaveExam",

		cs.IsLockedMark,
		cs.IsLockedExam1,
		cs.IsLocked,

		CONVERT(bit,0) as "IsEdit"

	From #tblData d
		Inner join #tblCS cs on cs.ClassSubjectID = d.ClassSubjectID
		Inner join #tblClass cls on cls.ClassID = cs.ClassID
		Inner join SIM_Subject su on su.SubjectID = cs.SubjectID
		Inner join SIM_Science sc ON sc.ScienceID = cls.ScienceID
		Inner join SIM_Regulation rg on rg.RegulationID = cls.RegulationID
		Left join SIM_Teacher tc on tc.TeacherID = cs.TeachingBy

END
